twin_model.primitives.sink module

Sink primitive for product collection in manufacturing.

This module provides a sink primitive that collects finished products exiting the production system. It tracks throughput, quality metrics, and delivery performance.

class twin_model.primitives.sink.SinkPrimitive(env, config, upstream=None)[source]

Bases: BasePrimitive

Generic sink that collects finished products.

Emits observables for: - Product collection events - Throughput metrics - Quality statistics - Order fulfillment - Delivery performance

__init__(env, config, upstream=None)[source]

Initialize sink with configuration.

Parameters:

  • env (Environment) – SimPy environment

  • config (PrimitiveConfig) – Sink configuration containing: - collection_rate: Maximum collection rate (units/minute) - quality_threshold: Minimum quality score for acceptance - target_throughput: Expected throughput for KPI - order_tracking: Whether to track order fulfillment

  • upstream (Optional[Any]) – Input buffer or equipment
